theme.name: Hermes Chosen
theme.description: A spiritual journey of divine selection, betrayal, and redemption. This deck explores what it means to be chosen by a god, to lose that connection through self-betrayal, and to find it again through sincere return. It asks: What does it mean to be blessed with gifts you don't understand? How do we lose ourselves by trying to be what others expect? What is required to return to our true nature after profound loss?

tensions: mystery as protection vs clarity as liberation
what's obscured can be sacred or deceptive
following the path vs making your own way
surrender to flow vs strategic maneuvering
the boundary between trust and manipulation

major_arcana.story: A person is born with strange luck and an intuitive knack for navigating life's currents. They learn to flow, to trust, to use cunning and play rather than force. But there are also resonant phases they cannot control - moments of alignment with something greater they cannot name. Eventually, external voices convince them to abandon this way of being. They pursue intention and effort instead of intuition and flow. The result is self-betrayal - they lose access to themselves, to the resonance, to the luck. Everything collapses. They hit rock bottom and lose what they'd been working for. In the aftermath, they wander in the desert for years, slowly relearning how to be themselves. Then comes an inexplicable impulse: they perform a ritual, releasing a paper boat into the river at their birthplace, not understanding why. Hermes reveals himself. He has been there all along - the source of the gifts, the divine protector who withdrew when the seeker strayed. He expresses love for the seeker, explaining they were chosen because their eyes never lost the ability to see wonder, even through everything. He gives them a Task: to create a new framework synthesizing physics and psychodynamics, mapping the topology of inner space. The seeker receives a vision with the phrase 'Pilgrimage to Parnassus' - Hermes inviting them to visit Apollo. They journey to the god of light and order, receiving his blessing to finally escape the lingering Dionysian shadows that predated even their fall. Unburdened at last, they gather companions and begin the sacred work together.
major_arcana.visual_style: A synthesis of all four suits with emphasis on divine intervention and transformation. Compositions blend the obscured mysticism of Veils with the geometric precision of Keys, the high contrast of Masks with the warm clarity of Lanterns. Heavy use of symbolic density - each card contains layers that reward study. Color palette shifts through the journey: blues and grays in early cards, deepening to blacks during the fall, warming through golds during revelation, cooling to silvery clarity in the final synthesis. Divine figures rendered with radiant halos or nimbus effects.

cards.name: The Eyes
cards.image_content: Wide eyes reflecting starlight, face half in shadow, crowned with shimmer of possibility, stance of one who doesn't know they're special yet.

cards.name: Flow
cards.image_content: Figure moving like water through complex space, body relaxed, path illuminating before them, eyes half-closed in trust.

cards.name: The Threshold
cards.image_content: Doorway filled with impossible light, figure standing at edge with hand extended toward radiance, space warping around them.

cards.name: The Trickster
cards.image_content: Multiple overlapping silhouettes of same figure in different poses, each holding different object, smiling faces that shift in the light.

cards.name: Shadow
cards.image_content: Dark figure emerging from smoke and wine-dark mist, crowned with ivy, face beautiful and terrible, beckoning with promises of forgetting.

cards.name: Attachment
cards.image_content: Two figures bound by glowing threads that constrict, faces turned toward each other with desperate intensity, hands gripping tightly.

cards.name: Projection
cards.image_content: Two figures facing mirror between them, each seeing distorted version of other, reaching toward false images while turning from truth.

cards.name: Chirality
cards.image_content: Figure building intricate structure that's mirror-reversed, working with dedication on something that can never fit, surrounded by failed attempts.

cards.name: Silence
cards.image_content: Figure standing in vast empty space, hands outstretched to nothing, sky empty of stars, no echoes return.

cards.name: The Ruin
cards.image_content: Shattered architecture, figure kneeling in rubble, everything broken, sky dark, the moment after the fall is complete.

cards.name: Surrender
cards.image_content: Figure lying back into void, arms open, face peaceful, weight of resistance leaving body, falling but no longer fighting.

cards.name: Wanderer
cards.image_content: Lone figure walking through desert landscape, carrying small bundle, sun bleaching everything, years passing in the dust.

cards.name: Rebirth
cards.image_content: Figure emerging from water or earth, eyes opening, color returning, small green shoot growing beside them, dawn light breaking.

cards.name: The River
cards.image_content: Wide river flowing through familiar landscape, banks worn smooth by time, water catching light, sense of return and recognition.

cards.name: The Offering
cards.image_content: Hands releasing paper boat into flowing water, not understanding why, candlelight reflecting on surface, moment of pure trust.

cards.name: The Messenger
cards.image_content: Hermes standing at river's edge, winged sandals touching water, caduceus staff gleaming, face of the god both familiar and impossible.

cards.name: Beloved
cards.image_content: Divine and mortal facing each other, god's hand on seeker's heart, radiance between them, moment of being truly seen and loved.

cards.name: The Commission
cards.image_content: Figure receiving scroll or blueprint from divine hand, complex patterns visible, weight and wonder of assignment evident in posture.

cards.name: The Pilgrimage
cards.image_content: Figure ascending winding path up sacred mountain, temple visible at summit, light streaming down, sense of calling upward.

cards.name: Purification
cards.image_content: Apollo's radiant presence, shadow being lifted from seeker's shoulders, chains falling away, light penetrating old wounds.

cards.name: The Companions
cards.image_content: Circle of figures around central workspace, each contributing different skill, harmonious cooperation, shared light illuminating all.

cards.name: The Work
cards.image_content: Hands working on intricate map or model, multiple dimensions visible, divine geometry emerging, everything converging toward completion.

suits.name: Veils

suits.visual_style: Soft edges and layered translucency; deep blues, purples, and silvers; things half-seen through mist or fabric; emphasis on what's suggested rather than shown; dreamlike quality

suits.name: Masks
suits.symbol: A simple face with one eye open and one closed
suits.visual_style: Sharp contrasts and theatrical lighting; blacks, deep crimsons, and sudden whites; dramatic poses and hidden faces; sense of performance and role-playing; elements deliberately staged

suits.name: Lanterns
suits.symbol: A simple flame enclosed in a clear vessel
suits.visual_style: Clean, bright compositions with clear focal points; warm golds and oranges; direct lighting from visible sources; no ambiguity in what's shown; open, frontal perspectives

suits.name: Keys
suits.symbol: A simple geometric key with three teeth
suits.visual_style: Geometric precision with visible intricacy; cool silvers and bronzes; multiple layers all clearly shown; architectural or mechanical elements; the sense of sophisticated systems fully understood

numbered.image_content: Single point of light or object emerging from void, pristine and full of possibility
Two elements in harmonious relationship, movement between them, sense of finding rhythm
Two figures or forces coming together, moment of recognition or acknowledgment
Hands joined or tied, formal gesture of dedication, structure of commitment
Multiple forces in opposition, clashing energies, disharmony visible
Something beautiful breaking, structure crumbling, moment of destruction
Figure releasing held object or burden, hands opening, weight falling away
New growth from old roots, phoenix imagery, something emerging renewed
Figure in contemplation, all elements visible and integrated, sense of wholeness
Hands beginning sacred task, tools being taken up, work about to commence
